title: Juan A. Uceda
vital_facts: Baptized at age 18; Priesthood in rapid sucession.
Missionary to Peru Lima South Mission 1974-76.
Bachelor's Degree in Public Relations San Luis Gonzaga University.
Married Maria Isabel Bendezu, 1979, Sao Paulo Brazil Temple; Five children.
Church Educational System area director in Peru and Bolivia. Since 2003, owned and operated a school in New Jersey, USA.
Bishop, Counselor in Stake Presidency, Stake President, Area Seventy.
President of the Peru Lima North Mission, 1992-95.
First Quorum of the Seventy, 2010 - present.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
